body:
sanjay: Quick status check on Optimize toolkit milestone — ETA for handing off quant profiles to infra?

mia: aiming EOD Tues for the initial profile set (int8 / q4_0). still finishing perf runs on long-seq cases.

oliver: heads-up: found a regression in batch sizing when prefix cache hits > 4k tokens. failing 2/12 long-run tests.

juniper: can you paste the failing log snippet? i can take a look after standup.

oliver: sure. gist: ```
ERROR: batch_coordinator.cc: line 218 - assert(batch_size <= max_batch)
context: sequence_len=8192, kv_cache_miss_ratio=0.72
config: batching: { target_tokens: 4096, max_batch: 8, timeout_ms: 20 }
```

sanjay: that suggests timeout-driven flushes creating oversized micro-batches; maybe decrease timeout for long-seq profiles or bump max_batch.

mia: agree. for q4_0 we set timeout_ms=20 to favor latency. for long sequences we should use timeout_ms=80 and target_tokens=8192.

juniper: proposed change: profile name `q4_longseq_batched` with timeout_ms=80, max_batch=16. i'll open a small PR to add it + tests.

oliver: thanks. also tagging @deploy-bot for canary rollout plan once PR is merged.

deploy-bot: noted. canary plan: 5% traffic for 2h then 25% for 4h if no perf regressions. will auto-rollback on p95 latency +10% or error-rate > 0.5%

irene: ownership clarification: eng-ml owns quant profile definitions, eng-runtime owns batching and rollout policy. confirm?

sanjay: correct. eng-ml (mia + oliver) for profile configs and perf validation. eng-runtime (juniper + sanjay) for rollout orchestration and safety gates.

mia: PR: github.com/redwood/inference/optimize-toolkit/pulls/189 — adds `q4_longseq_batched` and a unit test that simulates prefix cache hits.

juniper: will review now. if all good i'll merge and ping @deploy-bot.

oliver: after merge i’ll run the regression eval set (lexical + response-coherency) and post results here.

sanjay: great. one more ask: oliver, please add a small note in the profile metadata about recommended autoscale policy (min_gpu=1, target_util=0.6) so Dedicated teams can onboard safely.

oliver: done, updated PR description.

mia: small blocker: we observed a tokenization variance on one eval that changed embedding distance thresholds — opened #4523 in infra-evals. not blocking rollout but FYI.

sanjay: thanks — keep it posted. if regressions show up in canary we pause and revert.

juniper: merging now. will ping when deploy pipeline triggers.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: canary id=canary-2026-03-18-01

oliver: running evals now — will share numbers in ~45m.

mia: thx everyone :thumbsup:

sanjay: closing loop later today with a short postmortem if anything odd pops up.
